entries.title: Imua ʻIolani Quarter 2 Survey
entries.text: Imua wants to hear from you in our quarterly survey! What are your favorite foods from the One Team Wagon and from Trader Joe's? Should the U.S. government restrict social media usage for minors? And what sexual health topics should 'Iolani teach about more? Complete this survey by Friday to help represent the voice of the students. The survey should only take a few minutes.

entries.title: Future Business Leaders of America
entries.text: FBLA is excited to announce our upcoming school conference on Nov 24, with the award ceremony on Nov 25! Students can compete in a variety of events, with overall top scorers receiving a $50 gift card and finalists earning medals and certificates. ALL (you do not need to be in FBLA) interested students are encouraged to register and showcase their skills. Please register using this link by Nov 15: https://forms.gle/CzYHhN7MZPiWEwkw9 Please contact klp2801@iolani.org or ec2801@iolani.org for more information.

GRADUATION SUIT FITTING - Tomorrow, Fri 11/6 - Seto Hall - Please sign up for a 10- minute suit fitting appointment during your free period/lunch/after school here: Appointment Sign-Up Link. Slot times will become unavailable when filled (max 5 students per time slot). Email cco@iolani.org or come to College Counseling Office with any questions. Thank you!

entries.title: Senior Prefects
entries.text: Meeting today, 11/5, at lunch in the ASC 3F Commons. Lunch provided. GRS 9-12---ATTENTION ALL CREATIVE WRITERS: The University of Hawai‘i at Mānoa English Department is hosting a FREE day-long creative writing Write@Mānoa conference for students, teachers, and parents on Saturday, November 21, 2026. We’ll have a keynote address by the Pulitzer Prize finalist Tommy Orange, and lots of small workshops from how to build a fantasy world to how to perform poetry on stage! You can sign up using this Eventbrite link, and you can see more information at our W@M Conference website! If you sign up on Eventbrite by Thursday, you’ll also get a free lunch bento! If you have any questions, please contact Mx. Khactu (akhactu@iolani.org). GRS 10-12: STUDENTS TAKING THE SATURDAY, NOV 7 SAT EXAM: Check-in will open at 7:40 AM in the Weinberg 2F foyer and close promptly at 8 AM. On-campus parking will be available. Bring a valid, unexpired photo ID (physical document only; no photocopies or electronic versions), your fully charged student iPad and charger, your admission ticket, and writing utensils. If you need a school ID, please visit the AV Department before test day. You must open the Bluebook app on your ‘Iolani iPad and complete exam setup to obtain your admission ticket before check-in. Entry to Weinberg hallways will NOT be permitted until all testing has finished, so please plan ahead if you need to access your lockers.
